ITEM 1 | Large mound of white, soft, crumbly-looking pieces with irregular knobby edges and matte surface, spread across the left half of a white square plate, roughly 40% of plate footprint, about 3 cm tall at the thickest | 230
ITEM 2 | Olive-green to brownish translucent sauce with glossy sheen and chunky bits, drizzled over and pooled among the white crumbly pieces on the left side, covering about 20% of plate footprint, thin layer about 0.5 cm | 60
ITEM 3 | Orange cubes with slightly caramelized, glossy brown-orange edges and soft-looking surfaces, about 1.5 to 2 cm pieces, mixed with dark olive-brown glazed sauce, clustered on the upper right of the plate next to the fruit, covering about 12% of plate footprint, roughly 2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 4 | Small dark blueberries, deep blue with slight sheen, whole and about 1 cm across, scattered among the orange cubes and fruit on the right side | 25
ITEM 5 | Red strawberry pieces, bright red with pale flesh, cut into irregular wedges and chunks about 1.5 to 2.5 cm, moist and juicy-looking, on the lower right beside the other fruit | 70
ITEM 6 | Red watermelon cubes, bright pink-red with slightly glossy moist surface, about 2 cm cubes, arranged in a cluster along the lower right edge of the plate | 85
ITEM 7 | Orange-tan melon cubes, pale orange flesh with slightly matte moist surface, about 2 cm cubes, in a group with the strawberry and watermelon pieces on the right side | 75
